title: Geometric supported restriction is evaluation on the étale stalk
statement: For the finite affine-line zero-section Gysin object, there is one étale model H of its degree-zero cohomology such that, at every algebraically closed geometric point y, a canonical transport and a fixed isomorphism from the stalk of H to the fibre supported cohomology intertwines evaluation of every section with the canonical supported pullback. This is the supported-Hom and pullback calculation of Step 4 of prop-pur-affine-line-orientation-uniqueness, before any use of stalk conservativity.

source.place: proof Step 4; relative Kummer geometric base change

proof.text: Use the degree-zero étale Gysin model and the normalized supported-Hom comparison. On injective representatives its cocycle normalization identifies the displayed support chart with the exceptional counit.

Pull back the closed pair with the unit-normalized support map. The supported-Hom pullback theorem and the comparison square give inverse image of the section. Relative Kummer and its geometric base change identify the inverse image Gysin line with the fibre support group. On an algebraically closed field global sections equal the étale geometric stalk; evaluation at the constant unit gives the asserted identity for every section.

theorem affineLine_support_stalk (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    (h : P.ramificationIndex ∣ P.level) (Y : Scheme.{u})
    (a : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of P.field.k))
    [IsSeparated a] [LocallyOfFiniteType a] [QuasiCompact a]
    (chart : OrientationSupportData P h Y) :
    ∃ (H : EtSheaves P Y)
      (e : (comparisonUpperStar (Modules P) Y).obj H ≅
        (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ProSheaves P Y) 0).obj (P.gysinValue h Y)),
    ∀ (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] [Algebra P.field.k Ω]
      (y : Spec (CommRingCat.of Ω) ⟶ Y)
      (_hy : y ≫ a = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.field.k Ω))),
    ∃ p : proEtaleSupportHomTransport P (zeroSection Y)
        (zeroSection (Spec (CommRingCat.of Ω))) (AffineSpace.map (ULift.{u} (Fin 1)) y),
    ∃ v : (((Scheme.pointSmallEtale y).ulift.{u + 1}).sheafFiber (A := Modules P)).obj H ≅
      P.gysinSupport h (Spec (CommRingCat.of Ω)),
    ∀ f : P.constantEtale Y ⟶ H,
      P.orientationSupportRestriction h y p
        (chart.support.hom (P.gysinEvaluate Y
          ((comparisonUpperStar (Modules P) Y).map f ≫ e.hom))) =
        v.hom (P.orientationEtaleUnitGerm f y)
